name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-filesystem
description: Reads, writes, replaces, lists and searches files only inside the working copy a session names.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_ROOTS__0
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path the agent works in; add ROOTS__1 and so on for more. Nothing outside them is reachable, and without one nothing is served.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to answer sessions on, each naming its own working copy at /mcp?root=…; unset means the server is started as a program and speaks stdio to its parent.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Whether write_file and edit_file do anything; a role that only reads is given a server that only reads.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_OUTPUT_LIMIT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Characters of file text one call may return before it is cut; the answer says when it was.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_MAX_FILE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Bytes past which a file is not read as text at all.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_MAX_MATCHES
environmentVariables.description: Matches one search or listing may return.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_STEP_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Steps one run_tools call may take.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_ROOTS__0
environmentVariables.description: The volume the working copies live in; add ROOTS__1 and so on for more. A root a session names must lie inside it and one that names none is served it whole; without it every session is refused, the root it names too.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to answer sessions on, each naming its own working copy at /mcp?root=…; unset means the server is started as a program and speaks stdio to its parent.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Whether write_file and edit_file do anything; a role that only reads is given a server that only reads.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_OUTPUT_LIMIT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Characters of file text one call may return before it is cut; the answer says when it was.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_MAX_FILE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Bytes past which a file is not read as text at all.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_MAX_MATCHES
environmentVariables.description: Matches one search or listing may return.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_FILESYSTEM_STEP_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Steps one run_tools call may take.
